### What the reverse reading reveals

The session looked mechanical — 7 pages, same patterns repeated, dark aesthetic, gold accents, html2canvas exports. A factory line of coaching tools. Read forward, that's all it was: a build sprint.

Read backward, something different happened. The curriculum existed only in Paul's head and in the SERIES_PRESETS JavaScript object. Kids walked in, learned jabs, left. Their progress was Paul's memory. The series system was real in the ring but invisible everywhere else.

This session's actual work was making the invisible visible. Not adding features — adding *legibility*. A curriculum map that shows where you are. A passport that remembers what you've done. A block card that counts down to completion. A class summary that proves the session happened.
